inlineContent.text: The app target is where the features compose. It owns every reducer, built with The Composable Architecture: the screen, the stream, the settings sheet, connectivity and path switching, pairing, sound, and the Mac display choice. It also owns every view, the dependency clients the reducers reach the hardware through, and the input layer that turns UIKit and GameController events into input events and hands them to the active input path. It does not own the hardware code. Capture, the preview and render path, and the card model live in
; HID reports and the Bluetooth peripheral in
; input events and keyboard layouts in
; the helper link and its wire format in
. The packages expose clients and value types, and only the app imports
